# SSG Themes

> Three production themes for Static Site Generator (SSG): Apex, Atlas and
> Velocity. Each has its own design system and layout set, built on a shared
> template architecture, with every accessibility and performance claim
> enforced by a CI gate.

## Themes

- [Apex](https://ssg-themes.github.io/apex/): portfolio and consulting theme. Cool neutrals, deep blue accent, seven layouts.
- [Atlas](https://ssg-themes.github.io/atlas/): editorial and knowledge-hub theme. Serif reading column at a 72-character measure, forest-green accent, eight layouts.
- [Velocity](https://ssg-themes.github.io/velocity/): product landing and starter theme. Slate and bronze, seven layouts, the smallest of the three.

## Verified properties

- WCAG 2.2 AA, checked by axe-core and the generator's own accessibility pass; 0 issues across 15 pages.
- Colour tokens clear WCAG 1.4.6 AAA contrast (7:1 for text, 3:1 for borders and focus rings) in both light and dark; 102 token pairs gated.
- Zero third-party requests on every page: no CDN, webfont host, analytics or tag manager.
- Under 7 KB gzipped per page including CSS and JS, against a 20 KB budget.

## Not claimed

- Not full WCAG AAA conformance: AAA includes manual criteria no theme can satisfy alone. The themes target AA.
- No fixed Lighthouse score: Lighthouse runs in CI but a score depends on host and network.

## Requirements

Requires ssg 0.0.49 or later. Source: https://github.com/sebastienrousseau/ssg-themes.github.io
